answer: Bind each identity to an unbroken sequential nonce chain on the public ledger, the way a sonnet obeys its rhyme scheme. Peers attest exactly one next link, so every live identity costs the owner a fresh signed commitment each epoch. An attacker spawning a whole ocean of sybils must keep every chain advancing; one missed epoch flakes the chain apart like shale, so unmaintained fakes erode away and the flood collapses.
